title: Transverse analytic envelopes and integrability
summary: We associate normal toric transverse analytic envelopes with the singular orbits of diagonal holomorphic actions, and construct their canonical flat transport. At independent singular supports, the semiglobal first-integral algebra is determined by periodic resonances; complete integrability is equivalent to full resonance rank and finite envelope monodromy. We classify labelled residual actions with a fixed envelope by Grassmannian families and reconstruct the ambient weights from the labelled quotient and logarithmic residues at full resonance rank.
